source_identity.candidate: AgentDevel: Reframing Self-Evolving LLM Agents as Release Engineering

published_claim.paper: AgentDevel: Reframing Self-Evolving LLM Agents as Release Engineering, arXiv:2601.04620v1, submitted 2026-01-08
published_claim.mechanism: Maintain one canonical agent version line; diagnose execution failures, synthesize exactly one release candidate, compare incumbent and candidate on the same development tasks, and promote under flip-centered gating that treats fail-to-pass and pass-to-fail changes as first-class evidence.

official_artifact_support.paper_support: The paper specifies the single-line RC loop, D_train versus once-used D_test separation, flip metrics, per-iteration StableToolBench release decisions, WebArena ablations, and Claude Code + Claude-Sonnet-4.5 as the experimental agent stack.

author_associated_public_repo.assessment: Static interactive dashboard linked to arXiv:2601.04620; it is not an executable AgentDevel implementation and contains no public run bundle, benchmark split manifest, RC history, critic outputs, diagnostic scripts, or flip-list dataset needed for replay.

official_artifact_support.paper_artifact_statement_scope: The paper says diagnostic scripts, RC diffs, critic outputs and flip lists are saved/versioned for auditability, but this audit did not locate a public source-matched bundle containing them. Internal auditability is therefore not equivalent to public replayability.

reproducibility_findings.finding: The concrete experimental gate cannot be reconstructed from the paper's reported principles alone.
reproducibility_findings.evidence: The paper deliberately does not prescribe universal gating thresholds. In the StableToolBench trace, iteration 11 is rejected even though its reported P2F rate is only 0.4%, lower than several accepted iterations, so the accept/reject sequence is not inferable from a simple reported P2F cutoff. Exact hit-rate, intent-compliance or other decision thresholds are not disclosed.

reproducibility_findings.finding: Stopping behavior is not exactly replayable.
reproducibility_findings.evidence: Stopping criteria are described qualitatively/configurably, but concrete thresholds and exact invocation-level stopping parameters are not reported.

reproducibility_findings.finding: Data and model execution identities are insufficiently pinned for exact replay.
reproducibility_findings.evidence: This audit did not locate exact D_train/D_test instance-ID manifests, a frozen Claude-Sonnet-4.5 serving snapshot, a run-level critic seed, or a complete immutable environment/dependency bundle for the reported benchmark runs.

reproducibility_findings.finding: Reported safety/utility trade-off is meaningful but uncertainty is not quantified.
reproducibility_findings.evidence: On the reported WebArena ablation, removing the flip gate slightly raises endpoint test score from 34.2 to 35.0 while P2F rises from 3.1% to 14.8% and bad releases from 0 to 4. No multi-seed variability, confidence interval or significance analysis was located, so the magnitude cannot be promoted beyond the reported run(s).

reproducibility_findings.finding: No protocol-matched independent rerun was located in the fresh public search.
reproducibility_findings.evidence: Searches for AgentDevel code/reproduction/replication surfaced the paper, summaries, the author-associated static dashboard, and derivative design discussions, but no third-party execution matching the reported AgentDevel protocol.

scope_corrections: Treat the benchmark improvements and release traces as primary-study evidence, not independently reproduced performance.

The reported once-used D_test boundary, if followed as described, protects against direct final-test selection but does not make repeated D_train gating anytime-valid or control cumulative false-promotion risk across releases.
Do not interpret the flip gate as a universal non-regression guarantee: the paper reports a configurable gate and no universal thresholds.
Do not infer that lower P2F necessarily maximizes final task score; the WebArena ablation itself shows a safety/utility trade-off.
Do not treat the static dashboard as source code or replay evidence.

independent_replication.notes: No protocol-matched third-party reproduction or failure report was located. Derivative descriptions/proposals were excluded from reproduction evidence.

o_specific_adaptation.scope: This audit evaluates the source-qualified AgentDevel evidence only. Any transfer to another persistent self-improvement/release system requires its own matched experiment and must not inherit AgentDevel's reported benchmark effect sizes.

reopen_conditions: An official executable AgentDevel repository or immutable experiment release appears.
The source-matched diagnostic scripts, RC diffs, critic outputs, flip lists, exact split manifests, model/runtime identities and gate/stopping thresholds are released.
A protocol-matched independent rerun or failure report appears.
A repeated-release study adds candidate-local anytime-valid evidence or global risk accounting while preserving nonzero accepted beneficial edits on stateful software/web/tool benchmarks.
result: AgentDevel provides meaningful primary-study evidence that a persistent single-line release-candidate loop with regression-aware gating can accept nonzero edits and reduce reported release regressions on execution-heavy benchmarks. Public replayability is materially weaker than the paper's internal auditability claim: the located author-associated repository is a static dashboard, no raw run bundle or executable pipeline was found, concrete gate/stopping thresholds are not recoverable, and no matched independent rerun was located. The defensible grade is B overall/B+ primary evidence/C exact replay, with no claim of universal or statistically anytime-valid non-regression.
exact_next_action: At the next bootstrap-valid invocation, audit a different exact-wave non-evaluation candidate whose uncertainty can be reduced by runnable artifacts, exact formulas, raw receipts or independent reproduction/failure evidence. Do not repeat AgentDevel unless a reopen condition is met.
